liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Holinshed’s Chronicles (London, 1577): William Harrison’s Description of England
liebermann.notes: Harrison's Description of England prefixed to Holinshed's Chronicle (1577); f. 89v Ps Cn for. From Ho derive Ho 2 (the 1587 edition), Additional 6668 and Harley 785, 814. The Description also has Iud Dei XVI in English translation, perhaps from Ld and Co.

entries.text_de: Vor Holinshed's Chronicle of England (Lond. 1577) steht Description of England von W. H[arrison]; in dieser f. 89b Ps Cn for, u. S. 620. Aus Ho flossen Ho 2 (d. i. Ausgabe 1587), Additional 6668, Harley 785. 814. Die Description enthält auch II 9 (I p. 299 der Ausg. von 1807) Iud Dei XVI, u. S. 427, Englisch übersetzt, aus Ld und Co?
entries.text_en: In front of Holinshed's Chronicle of England (London 1577) stands the Description of England by W. H[arrison]; in it, f. 89b Ps Cn for, below, p. 620. From Ho derived Ho 2 (i.e. the edition of 1587), Additional 6668, Harley 785. 814. The Description also contains, at II 9 (I p. 299 of the edition of 1807), Iud Dei XVI, below, p. 427, translated into English, from Ld and Co?

transcription.doubts: Runs from the foot of col. 1 to the top of col. 2 of p. xxx; 'H[arri-' / 'son]' joined across the column break.
